title: LIVEBENCH: A CHALLENGING, CONTAMINATION-LIMITED LLM BENCHMARK

bias_targets.target: Evaluation bias (LLM-as-a-judge and human preference bias)
bias_targets.methodology: Comparing model performance and rankings on an objective, ground-truth scored benchmark (LiveBench) against benchmarks that use LLM judges or human crowdsourcing (such as Arena-Hard and ChatBot Arena) to highlight discrepancies and outlier performances caused by biases toward verbosity, specific output formatting, style, and LLM self-preference.

primary_bias_target: Evaluation bias (LLM-as-a-judge and human preference bias)
